# instr-trace

```text
usage: instr-trace [-h] [-v] trace_file end_address

```

Dumps an instruction trace to disk.

This command will execute consecutive single steps from the current pc, until the end_address is reached or the program exits.
Saving each pc to a file on disk. If -v is passed the backing file of the memory region will also be saved.
### Positional arguments

|Positional Argument|Help|
| :--- | :--- |
|trace_file|A path to write the trace file.|
|end_address|The end address to stop tracing.|

### Optional arguments

|Short|Long|Help|
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
|-h|--help|show this help message and exit|
|-v|--verbose|Flag to dump backing file.|

### Examples
```text
instr-trace /tmp/trace.txt 0x555555555158 -v
```
